source: Frostfell was not always one kingdom. It was split in two, the North and the South. In the North, the non magical kingdom. To the South, a kingdom full of fantastical displays of power. Due to the North’s greed, the two kingdoms clashed in a never ending war, until the South offered a truce.
text: Frostfell var ekki alltaf eitt konungsríki. Það var skipt í tvennt, Norður og Suður. Norður var konungsríkið án töfrakrafta. Suður var konungsríki fullt af dásamlegum sýnum af mátt og megni. Vegna græðgi Norðurs steyptust konungsríkin í endalausan stríð, þar til Suður bauð upp á friðarsamning.

source: 0430 Itania time. Cohren hated waking up this early. Mainly because it was his responsibility to wake everyone else up in his company. Silently stepping out of his bunk, he put on his combat fatigues, throwing on his assault vest, and packed up his belongings from his locker, being careful with a particular small box. He shoulded his rifle and put his helmet on a small hook connected to his belt. It had all its fixing, respirator, goggles, everything needed. After checking his ammo pouches, he quietly walked out of the barracks, mud and ice squelching under his boots.
text: 0430 Ítalskt tími. Cohren hataði að vakna svona snemma. Aðallega vegna þess að það var hans ábyrgð að vekja alla aðra í fyrirtækinu sínu. Hann fór ósýnilega úr rúminu sínu, klæddist bardagafötum sínum, setti á sig árásarvestið sitt og pakkaði sínum eignum úr skápnum sínum, en var varkár með sérstaka litla kassa. Hann bar riffilinn sinn og setti hettuna sína á litla hengi sem tengdist belti hans. Það hafði allt sem þurfti, andlitsgrímur, gleraugu, allt sem þurfti. Eftir að hafa skoðað skotfærin sín, fór hann rólega út úr herberginu, með mýri og ís undir skónum sínum.

source: He took a lighter from his jacket pocket and a cig from the other. Lighting it, he took a small drag before opening the door slightly. Over the last week he had to get creative when waking the men and women under his command. He stopped using the preset wake up alarm, half the time it never worked, when all that came from the speakers was a light hiss.
text: Hann tók léttara úr jakkafötunum sínum og sígarettu úr öðrum. Hann kveikti á henni og tók litla drögin áður en hann opnaði dyrnar aðeins. Á síðustu viku hafði hann að verða skapandi þegar hann vakti karla og konur undir sínu stjórn. Hann hætti að nota fyrirfram stillta vekjarann, helmingurinn af tímanum sem hann aldrei virkaði, þegar allt sem kom úr hátölurunum var létt hiss.

source: Kayel clearly didn't agree with Nyssi, he looked less black than normal and his claws had dug into Thassalin's back to the point that he'd made the Thraki bleed, but Thassalin clearly didn't seem to care. That being said, Thassalin had realized he had scared his new friends and found a clearing to land in.

Að því sögðu hafði Þassalín áttað sig á að hann hafði hrætt nýju vini sína og fundið rjóður til að lenda í.

source: 0430 Itania time. Cohren hated waking up this early. Mainly because it was his responsibility to wake everyone else up in his company. Silently stepping out of his bunk, he put on his combat fatigues, throwing on his assault vest, and packed up his belongings from his locker, being careful with a particular small box. He shoulded his rifle and put his helmet on a small hook connected to his belt. It had all its fixing, respirator, goggles, everything needed. After checking his ammo pouches, he quietly walked out of the barracks, mud and ice squelching under his boots.
text: 04:30 Ítalskur tími. Cohren hataði að vakna svona snemma. Meginlega vegna þess að það var hans ábyrgð að vekja alla hina í hópnum. Hljóðlaust gekk hann út úr herberginu sínu, setti á sig bardagafatigues, setti á sig herta vesti og pakkaði dótinu sínu úr skápnum, með sérstökum litlum kassa. Hann setti riffilinn sinn á herðapinn og setti hjálm sinn á lítinn hring sem var tengdur belti hans. Það hafði allt sitt festingar, andardráttarvél, græjur, allt sem þurfti. Eftir að hafa skoðað skotfærapoka sína gekk hann hljóðlega út úr herberginu, vatn og ís skríkjandi undir skónum hans.

source: He took a lighter from his jacket pocket and a cig from the other. Lighting it, he took a small drag before opening the door slightly. Over the last week he had to get creative when waking the men and women under his command. He stopped using the preset wake up alarm, half the time it never worked, when all that came from the speakers was a light hiss.

Hann hafði hætt að nota vakningarklukkuna, sem virkaði sjaldnast, og í staðinn notaði hann hljóðmerki í talstöð.
